import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import warnings
import os
import time

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Disable progress bars and downloads
os.environ["LIGHTGBM_DOWNLOAD_MODE"] = "0"
os.environ["LBG_ENABLE_PROGRESS_BAR"] = "0"

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
start_time = time.time()
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
print(f"Data loaded in {time.time() - start_time:.2f}s")

# Identify features and target
target_col = "Cover_Type"
id_col = "Id"
feature_cols = [col for col in train.columns if col != id_col and col != target_col]

# Separate features and target
X_train_full = train[feature_cols]
y_train_full = train[target_col]
X_test = test[feature_cols]
test_ids = test[id_col]

print(f"\nTraining set: {len(X_train_full)} samples, {len(feature_cols)} features")
print(f"Target classes: {y_train_full.nunique()}")
print(
    f"Target distribution:\n{y_train_full.value_counts().sort_values(ascending=False)}"
)

# INCREASED training sample size to 130K to leverage more data
# Previous solution: 100K -> 0.9437 accuracy
# Solution_v1 evidence: 130K -> 0.949692 accuracy (within time budget)
# 43 min used out of 56 min = 13 min headroom for additional samples
print("\nSubsampling training data to 130,000 samples...")
sample_size = 130000
sample_indices = np.random.choice(len(X_train_full), sample_size, replace=False)
X_train_subsample = X_train_full.iloc[sample_indices]
y_train_subsample = y_train_full.iloc[sample_indices]

print(f"Sampled training set: {len(X_train_subsample)} samples")

# Hold-out validation split - non-stratified due to rare classes (Cover_Type 5 has only 1 sample)
print("\nCreating validation split (non-stratified)...")
X_train_fold, X_val, y_train_fold, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_subsample, y_train_subsample, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=None
)

print(f"Train fold size: {len(X_train_fold)}, Validation size: {len(X_val)}")

# Convert labels to 0-indexed for LightGBM (Cover_Type is 1-indexed: 1-7 -> 0-6)
y_train_fold = y_train_fold - 1
y_val = y_val - 1

# LightGBM parameters optimized for speed (preserved from base solution)
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": y_train_full.nunique(),
    "metric": "multi_logloss",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "max_depth": 5,
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "n_estimators": 150,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "random_state": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
    "subsample_for_bin": 200000,
    "force_col_wise": True,
}

# Create LightGBM datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train_fold, label=y_train_fold)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# Train model
print("\nTraining LightGBM model...")
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=150,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(20, verbose=False)],
)

# Evaluate on hold-out validation set (convert back to 1-indexed)
print("Evaluating on validation set...")
val_pred = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
val_pred_classes = np.argmax(val_pred, axis=1)
# Convert predictions back to 1-indexed for accuracy calculation
val_pred_classes_1idx = val_pred_classes + 1
y_val_1idx = y_val + 1
validation_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val_1idx, val_pred_classes_1idx)
print(f"Hold-out Validation Accuracy: {validation_accuracy:.6f}")

# Generate final predictions on test set
print("\nGenerating submission...")
final_pred = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
final_pred_classes = np.argmax(final_pred, axis=1)
# Convert predictions back to 1-indexed (Cover_Type 1-7)
final_pred_classes = final_pred_classes + 1

# Create and save submission file - PRESERVED EXACTLY FROM BASE SOLUTION
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"Id": test_ids.values, "Cover_Type": final_pred_classes.astype(int)}
)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Submission preview:\n{submission.head()}")

## Fusion Decision

I anchored on the **previous solution's core architecture** because it successfully completed within the 56-minute limit and correctly handled the critical non-stratified split (Cover_Type 5 has only 1 sample, making stratified splits invalid). I trusted the **solution_v1 outcome** which reported validation accuracy **0.949692** (vs. base 0.943700) after increasing training samples from 100K to 130K, while still completing successfully. I discarded solution_v0 (Type error with invalid Dataset parameter), solution_v2 (incomplete distance feature detection - only 2 of ~8 distance features transformed), and solution_v3 (ensemble at 0.9473 was worse than solution_v1's 0.949692). The final plan: adopt solution_v1's 130K sample size while preserving all validated preprocessing, validation split, label conversion, and submission code from the base solution.
